# Sensual Movement USA — front door (preview by PlexAura)

> Sensual bachata festivals, weekly socials, classes and training by Sensual Movement USA. Every fact below is from sensualmovementusa.com; no prices are listed here — the ticket links are the source of truth.

## Festivals (by date)
- Punta Cana Bachata Beach Paradise 2026: 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-02 · Meliá Caribe Beach Resort · tickets: https://www.tickettailor.com/events/smeeventsinternational/2118354 · details: https://sensualmovementusa.com/punta-cana-bachata-beach-paradise-2026/
- Sensual Movement 11th Anniversary: 2027-02-11 to 2027-02-15 · Hyatt Regency Orlando · tickets: https://www.tickettailor.com/events/smdancecompany/2068265 · hotel: https://www.hyatt.com/events/en-US/group-booking/MCORO/G-SMD1 · details: https://sensualmovementusa.com/sensual-movement-11th-anniversary/
- Sensual Movement Paris France 2027: 2027-04-22 to 2027-04-26 · H4 Wyndham Paris Pleyel · tickets: https://buytickets.at/smdancelife/2185407 · details: https://sensualmovementusa.com/sensual-movement-paris-france-2027/
- Miami Bachata Paradise 2027: 2027-06-17 to 2027-06-21 · Hyatt Regency, 400 SE 2nd St · tickets: https://buytickets.at/smdancesyndicateinc/2242926 · hotel: https://www.hyatt.com/en-US/group-booking/MIARM/G-7505 · details: https://sensualmovementusa.com/miami-bachata-paradise-2027/
- Empire Sensual Movement 2027: 2027-07-29 to 2027-08-02 · New York Marriott Marquis · tickets: https://buytickets.at/smeevents/2340162 · details: https://sensualmovementusa.com/empire-sensual-movement-nyc-2027/

## Weekly socials, classes, privates and training (by city)
- nyc: social — Friday Bachata Sensual Nights · Fridays · dancing from 10 PM · 224 W 35th St, 15th floor · https://sensualmovementusa.com/product/socials/nyc-socials/friday-bachata-sensual-nights-social-party/
- nyc: social — Roofchata Wednesdays at 230 Fifth · Every Wednesday · class 9 PM · dancing 10 PM – 1 AM · 230 5th Ave · https://sensualmovementusa.com/product/socials/nyc-socials/roofchata-wednesdays-bachata-party/
- nyc: classes — Bachata classes · Levels 1 to 3 · Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays · 224 West 35th Street, 15th floor · https://sensualmovementusa.com/sensual-bachata-classes-new-york-city-ny/
- nyc: privates — Private packages · https://sensualmovementusa.com/private-packages/
- nyc: training — New York Intensive Training Week · July 28–30, 2026 · Pearl Studio, 500 8th Ave · https://sensualmovementusa.com/new-york-intensive-training-week/
- orlando: program — Artist Development Program · Orlando · by application · https://sensualmovementusa.com/sensual-movement-usa-artist-development-program/
- chicago: classes — Sensual Movement Chicago · Classes, pre-social classes and socials · https://sensualmovementusa.com/sensual-movement-chicago/
- sf: classes — Bachata classes · Monday + Wednesday · Mondays and Wednesdays · https://sensualmovementusa.com/product/socials/san-francisco-socials/bachata-classes-monday-wednesday-san-francisco/
- sf: social — Sensual Movement San Francisco · Classes, socials and weekenders · https://sensualmovementusa.com/sensual-movement-san-francisco-bachata-sensual-classes-socials/
